checks.evidence: All four output sprites and final proof show irregular continuous ground; no repeated cell boundary or repeated patch grid.

checks.criterion: wet mud / puddle scars / reeds / new grass
checks.evidence: Dark wet areas, cracked puddle margins, cut golden reed clumps and small green grass appear in irregular placements.
Two narrow parallel depressions cross each region; subdued in summer, frost picks out edges in winter.
Smaller footprint retains fewer/appropriately compact major features, rather than making every feature microscopic.
Winter retains exposed dark soil with widespread thin frost and blue-grey frozen puddle remnants; no thick blanket of snow.
Dark drying earth and pale stubble/ice patches remain distinct from staked fen, drainage channels on fen, and finished grass.
Individual blades, fine cracks and separate cut reed stalks reduce to grouped texture; larger clumps and wet/ice patches remain.
